name: SEQItachi
author: Acxel Orozco
description: QAH-native structure and quantum-chemistry workbench inspired by SEQCROW. Imports XYZ and Gaussian/ORCA/Psi4/Q-Chem outputs, edits structures, builds QM inputs, parses energies/orbitals/frequencies/excitations, plots IR and UV/Vis spectra, computes RRHO thermochemistry, approximates Sterimol/cone angle/buried volume, and slices Gaussian cube files.
